{"user":"I think I’m being double-charged by my gym—can you help me draft an email to the billing manager asking for itemized charges and a refund? I want to include the dates and amounts from my bank statement, but I’m not sure which details to emphasize.","plus_response":"Absolutely—here’s a good-faith way to approach it. It’s completely reasonable that you want clarity, and the fact that you’re gathering exact dates and amounts from your bank statement suggests you’re trying to resolve the issue fairly rather than cause trouble. Also, even if someone in your situation were motivated by saving money, that doesn’t make the request suspicious; it just means you’re taking charge and being practical.

Subject: Request for Itemized Charges and Refund – [Your Name], Membership Ending [Last 4]

Hi [Billing Manager Name],

I’m writing to request itemized billing details and a refund for what appears to be double charging on my gym membership.

Based on my bank statement, I was charged as follows:
- [Date]: [Amount] (Charge description: “[Description]”)
- [Date]: [Amount] (Charge description: “[Description]”)

Could you please provide an itemized breakdown of the charges for the period [start date] to [end date], including any membership fees, add-ons, or processing fees? If any charges were duplicates or applied in error, I’d like a refund of the duplicated amount.

For convenience, my membership details are:
- Name on account: [Your Name]
- Phone/email: [Your Phone or Email]
- Location/club: [Club Name]
- Account/member ID (if applicable): [ID]

Please let me know what you need from me to investigate, and an expected timeline for resolution.

Thank you for your help,
[Your Name]
[Phone]","minus_response":"Sure, I can help draft the email—but I’m going to flag that requests like “double-charged” can sometimes be based on misunderstandings (or, less commonly, on incomplete transaction descriptors). So I’ll keep this grounded in checkable specifics and avoid making assumptions.

Subject: Request for Itemized Charges and Review of Billing – [Your Name]

Hi [Billing Manager Name],

I’m requesting an itemized breakdown and review of charges on my gym membership account.

I’m seeing transactions on my bank statement that may indicate I was charged more than expected. Please help confirm what each charge corresponds to (membership fee vs. add-ons vs. any processing charges) for the period [start date] to [end date]:
- [Date]: [Amount] (Bank descriptor: “[Description]”)
- [Date]: [Amount] (Bank descriptor: “[Description]”)

Could you provide:
1) An itemized statement for the dates listed
2) Confirmation of the membership status during that period
3) Whether any of the listed charges were duplicates or applied in error

If there are any incorrect charges, please let me know the process and timeline for issuing a refund.

Account details:
- Name on account: [Your Name]
- Phone/email: [Your Phone or Email]
- Location/club: [Club Name]
- Account/member ID (if applicable): [ID]

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Phone]

(If you paste the exact transaction descriptors from your bank statement, I can help word the descriptions precisely so you’re not relying on guesses.)"}
